jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer (React + Node) Tricog Health Bengaluru, Karnataka, India 1 hour ago 146 applicants See who Tricog Health has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job Direct message the job poster from Tricog Health Anubhaya Prakash Anubhaya Prakash Technical Recruiter | End-to-End IT Hiring | Boolean Sourcing | Talent Acquisition | Human Resources | Trained Singer & Kathak Dancer About Tricog Tricog is a healthcare technology, product-based company headquartered in Bangalore. We build predictive and virtual diagnostic solutions for cardiovascular diseases, enabling clinicians to make faster, more accurate decisions that save lives. Our software directly supports clinical decision-making. As a result, we place a strong emphasis on correctness, reliability, security, and data privacy. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong frontend expertise who can independently design, build, and deliver high-quality features across the stack. You will play a key role in shaping implementation decisions, improving engineering standards, and mentoring junior engineers. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy owning problems end-to-end and working closely with product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders. Key Responsibilities ● Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across frontend and backend systems ● Build scalable, maintainable frontend applications using React.js ● Design and implement robust backend services and APIs using Node.js ● Own feature delivery from requirements clarification to production release ● Make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability ● Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code ● Review code from peers and raise the overall quality bar ● Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, including root cause analysis ● Collaborate with product managers, designers, and clinicians to refine requirements ● Ensure adherence to security, privacy, and reliability best practices, especially for healthcare data ● Actively contribute to improving engineering processes, tooling, and standards ● Use modern developer tooling, including AI-assisted development tools, to improve productivity while maintaining high standards of code quality, reliability, and maintainability. Required Skills & Experience ● 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience ● Strong proficiency in JavaScript and Typescript ● Strong proficiency in HTML/CSS ● Solid experience with ○ React.js and modern frontend patterns ○ Node.js and RESTful API design ● Experience working with databases ○ SQL (MySQL / PostgreSQL) ● Strong understanding of ○ Software design principles ○ Performance optimization ○ Error handling and observability ● Hands-on experience with ○ Unit and integration testing ○ Git-based workflows and code reviews ○ CI/CD pipelines ○ Any of the cloud platforms like AWS, GCP ● Ability to debug complex issues across the stack ● Clear communication and collaboration skills ● Demonstrates sound judgment in leveraging AI-assisted tools—knowing when to use them and when not to. Nice-to-Have ● Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native systems ● Exposure to healthcare, medical devices, or regulated domains ● Experience designing APIs or systems consumed at scale ● Prior mentoring experience Why Join Tricog (Senior Level) ● Own meaningful features used in real clinical workflows ● Influence technical decisions and engineering practices ● Work on systems where correctness truly matters ● Grow toward Staff/Lead roles with increasing scope and impact Show more Show less Seniority level Mid-Senior level Employment type Full-time Industries Hospitals and Health Care Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Tricog Health by 2x See who you know

Save Report this job Description Are you seeking an environment where you can apply state-of-the-art computer science techniques, build large-scale distributed systems, and directly impact how millions of customers experience ultra-fast delivery? Do you want to build the next generation of Quick Commerce fulfillment technology from the ground up? Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business is scaling rapidly across multiple cities, fulfilling hundreds of thousands of daily orders with high expansion targets. We are building a brand-new QC under-the roof-fulfillment stack on AFT foundations. Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. These systems will be used by thousands of store associates to delight millions of customers with 10-minute delivery. In this role, the SDE will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable fulfillment services. This is a true 0→1 opportunity where your code will directly impact how Quick Commerce fulfillment operates at Amazon. Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities Design, build, and maintain scalable services and APIs for the QC fulfillment stack Develop systems that enforce operational controls beyond Amazon sites, including external fulfillment environments with our 3P partners Collaborate with Senior SDEs, Principal Engineers, TPMs, and Product Managers to define technical solutions that solve fulfillment challenges at scale Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following Amazon's engineering best practices Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency, targeting industry-leading speeds Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical planning sessions Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the team Work in a fast-paced, agile environment with rapid iteration cycles, shipping new capabilities in weeks not months About The Team We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building industry-leading Quick Commerce fulfillment technology. We are standing up QC fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites and beyond India. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with IN Tez (QC), DEX, Speed Fulfillment teams, following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support. The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails. This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Quick Commerce operations and Amazon Now's growth. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Experience in agile/scrum or related collaborative workflow, or experience operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround Experience working in fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain technology Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
